reason: A DSH web plugin for accepting arbitrary files by drag-and-drop, storing or referencing them locally, inserting file references for agents, and managing the local upload directory.

summaries.zh: 通过拖拽接收任意文件，将其上传或引用到本机并以文件引用插入 DSH 输入框，同时提供本地上传目录清理功能。
summaries.en: Accepts arbitrary files by drag-and-drop, uploads or references them locally for agent access, inserts file references into DSH, and provides local upload-directory cleanup.

capabilities: Accepts arbitrary files through browser drag-and-drop
Uploads file data to a local host directory when direct path access is unavailable
References local file paths for agent access
Writes manifests and uploaded file data to the local filesystem
Deletes selected files or clears the local upload directory through cleanup controls
Exposes local HTTP routes for upload, listing, cleanup, and session management
